CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Winter-2013 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Winter-2013 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 604 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 2 benchmark sites in 2 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: June 2013 to June 2013). These surveys captured 1 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 5 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 422 cards across 32 sites, with 3.8% showing evidence of mouse activity (16 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 56 transects across 32 sites (survey period: June 2013 to June 2013), detecting active burrows in 0% of transects (total: 0 active burrows).
